entry.summary: Bluff Hill Inspection Works: Breakwater Road (SH50) - Stop/Go People in Place. Breakwater Road (SH50) - at the Napier Port southern entrance just past Coote Road - will be CLOSED from midday on Monday 1 October. The reason? Investigations are required to assess the stability of the Napier Hill along this section of road.
